originating_goal: Preserve canonical Healer synchronization without GitHub-hosted schedules, GitHub release transport, repository push credentials, or broad unscoped mirroring.
claim_release_condition: Satisfied by superseding the generic sync mechanism. A future import requires a new exact Healer-scoped StegDB candidate and TVC-bounded import authorization; no standing generic import claim remains.

supersession_evidence.stegdb_observation: StegDB canonical storage contains multiple package-specific authorities and does not expose a Healer-wide canonical package that safely authorizes generic overwrite of workflows, policy, schema, docs, roles_templates, or tools.

future_trigger: A StegDB package manifest explicitly names StegVerse-Labs/StegVerse-Healer as consumer and provides exact source paths, hashes, version, import semantics, and authority boundaries.
future_owner: StegDB package owner + Healer consumer validator + TVC exact-scope mutation authorization
